courses_research_notes: Programs from official STI WNU admissions policy (stiwnu.com). Six colleges: CEAS, CCJE, CICT, CBMA, CHTM, COE. Also offers BS Tourism Management, BS Psychology, BS Mathematics, BS Management Accounting, BS Retail Technology and Consumer Science, BA Communication, BA English, and education degrees (BEEd, BSEd, BPEd, BECE) — omitted here in favor of engineering, IT, business, criminology, and hospitality flagship programs. Graduate MBA/MPA/MAEd/DBA/DPA/PhD offered but excluded.
